'''Business and economy'''
*[[European Union–United States relations]], [[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces the implementation of 50% [[tariff]]s on all goods imported from [[European Union]] countries starting June 1. [[Europe]]an [[stock exchange]]s including the [[Germany|German]] [[DAX]], the [[France|French]] [[CAC 40]], and the [[United Kingdom|British]] [[FTSE 100]] report losses afterwards. [https://www.dw.com/en/trump-calls-for-50-tariffs-on-eu-imports-from-june-1/a-72648246 (DW)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 260 miners are trapped after a [[mining accident|collapse]] at the [[KDC mine|KDC]] [[gold mining|gold mine]] near [[Carletonville]], [[Gauteng]], [[South Africa]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/rescue-efforts-underway-260-workers-trapped-south-african-122105145 (ABC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Canada–United States relations]]
**A group of [[United States Senate|U.S. senators]] visit [[Ottawa]], [[Canada]], to meet with [[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian prime minister]] [[Mark Carney]] in an effort to maintain the relationship between the two countries amidst [[2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico|Trump's tariffs]] on [[Canada|the country]] and calls to make it the [[51st state]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/05/23/us/senators-canada-meeting-trade.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Israel–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[United Kingdom|British]] [[Minister of State for the Armed Forces]] [[Luke Pollard]] says that the UK "does not recognize" the comments made by [[Israeli prime minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] yesterday, where he accused [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|British prime minister]] [[Keir Starmer]], along with [[President of France|French president]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] and [[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian prime minister]] [[Mark Carney]], of "siding with [[Hamas]]" and being on "the wrong side of humanity". [https://news.sky.com/story/israel-gaza-latest-youre-on-wrong-side-of-humanity-netanyahu-launches-attack-on-starmer-after-killings-in-us-13362469 (Sky News)]
*[[Guyana–Venezuela territorial dispute]]
**[[Guyana|Guyanese]] Foreign Minister [[Hugh Todd]] says that [[Guyana]] will defend its sovereignty in the face of [[Venezuela]]'s referendum next Sunday, passing a motion in parliament and reaffirming warnings that [[Venezuelans]] voting in the referendum in Guyana will be [[deported]]. [https://newsroom.gy/2025/05/23/guyana-will-not-be-bullied-threatened-or-intimidated-parliament-debates-motion-on-sovereignty/ (News Room Guyana)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024–2025 Georgian protests]]
**A court in [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] places opposition figure [[Zurab Japaridze]], a leader in the country's largest opposition group [[Coalition for Change (Georgia)|Coalition for Change]], in [[pre-trial detention]] for failure to appear before a parliamentary inquiry, after the group led protests against the [[government of Georgia (country)|current government]] and the ruling party [[Georgian Dream]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/georgia-jails-opposition-leader-amid-crackdown-on-dissent/a-72639056 (DW)]
*[[2025 Hamburg stabbing attack]]
**Seventeen people are injured, including four critically, in a [[mass stabbing]] at the [[Hamburg Hauptbahnhof| main train station]] in [[Hamburg]], [[Germany]]. A woman is arrested at the scene, and four [[railway platform|platforms]] are closed, according to [[Deutsche Bahn]]. [https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/regional/hamburg/hamburg-hauptbahnhof-messerangriff-100.html (Tagesschau)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/may/23/hamburg-train-station-stabbing-attack-germany (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2025 killing of Israeli Embassy workers in Washington, D.C.]]
**The suspect in the killing of two [[Embassy of Israel, Washington, D.C.|Israeli embassy]] workers in [[Washington, D.C.]] two days ago, is charged with two counts of [[Murder in the United States#degrees|first-degree]] [[murder]] along with other charges, both federally and locally. [https://www.npr.org/2025/05/22/nx-s1-5407572/israeli-embassy-staffers-killed-washington-dc (NPR)]
*Authorities from [[Canada]], [[Denmark]], [[France]], [[Germany]], [[the Netherlands]], the United Kingdom, and the U.S. announce a joint operation to crack down on [[malware]] around the world, which took down over 300 [[server (computing)|servers]], neutralized 650 [[domain name|domains]], and seized over {{Euro}}3.5 million (US$3.9 million) of [[cryptocurrency]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/global-operation-takes-down-dangerous-malware-network/a-72643612 (DW)]

*[[2024–25 Jamaica Premier League]]
**In [[association football]], [[Cavalier F.C.]] win their second consecutive and fourth ever [[Jamaican Premier League]] title after defeating [[Mount Pleasant F.A.]] 6–5 in a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] after a 0–0 draw in the play-off final. *[[2024–25 Serie A]]
**In association football, [[SSC Napoli]] win their fourth [[Lega Serie A|Serie A]] title and second title in three seasons after defeating [[Cagliari Calcio|Cagliari]] 2–0 on the final matchday. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/c1derv64npqt (BBC Sport)]
